museum: National Museum of Antiquities (Rijksmuseum van Oudheden)
possible_additional_holdings: AMM 16h found via Collectie Nederland OAI (not in Europeana). The reference chains (Leemans 1840 N 28-33, Boeser 1907 E.XLV.24-29, Raven/Taconis 2005 cat. 113-119) have one gap each (N 30 / E.XLV.25 / cat. 115), plausibly AMM 16h (unverified). RMO own DB blocked by Cloudflare, so further crocodile items (eggs, bundles) not in the portals cannot be excluded.

Educational museum in The Hague. Official CollectionConnection page is JS-rendered; record read via Europeana (dataset 2021657). Other animal mummies in same dataset: falcon, cat, fish.
